bug.title: The node export fails the very check /network tells readers to run: "scholium verify archive.car" says NOT VERIFIED
bug.symptoms: /network says to check the public export with `scholium verify archive.car` and that it exits 0 when everything checks out; on the untouched download (193,798 B) it prints "The version history is broken: the records describe 5 papers; name one with --paper" and "Result: NOT VERIFIED (4 checks failed)", exit 1; `scholium rebuild` on the same file succeeds (REBUILT, exit 0)
bug.reproduction_steps: Journey 09 step 5: download /v1/export/archive.car from the /network page, run the documented command (screenshots/09-preserve-and-transparency/05b-export-cli-verify-not-verified.png)
bug.expected: `scholium verify` recognises a whole-node archive (more than one paper) and verifies all of it: the event log's hash chain and signatures, every record's signature and content id, and each paper's version history separately, printing a per-paper summary and "Result: VERIFIED" with exit 0 for an untouched export (non-zero with the failing paper named when anything is wrong); `--paper` still narrows to one paper; a single-paper archive behaves as today; /network's instructions match the command's real behaviour; a test builds a multi-paper export through the API and verifies it with the CLI
bug.actual: The documented check fails on genuine data

bug.title: /verify keeps the previous file's verdict when a second file is dropped
bug.symptoms: Dropping the paper archive (.car) right after main.pdf leaves the drop box showing "main.pdf · 3.0 KB" and the green "This file matches ... main.pdf" card, with the archive hint added below; the on-screen verdict belongs to the wrong file (a fresh page gives only the hint)
bug.expected: Each new file replaces the previous selection and clears its result before the new check starts; the drop box names the file being checked and only that file's verdict or hint is shown
bug.actual: Stale verdict next to a new file

bug.title: After sign-out the header keeps the previous account's unread-notification badge; the header's second row starts with "·"
bug.symptoms: Right after Sign out on /, the header still shows the previous account's bell badge ("Notifications, 1 unread") until a reload (reproduced twice, over 6 s) The paper header's second meta row still begins with a stray "·" (sweep 6 finding, not fixed)
bug.reproduction_steps: Journey 03 step 7 (screenshots/03-new-member-onboarding/07a-signed-out.png); open any paper page (screenshots/01-read-feed-and-paper/)
bug.expected: Signing out clears every per-account client cache (unread count, notifications, my reviews, follows) in the same tick as the session, so the header shows the signed-out bell immediately; meta rows are joined so that no row starts or ends with a separator, at every width (a unit test renders the header with each optional part missing)

bug.title: Dates from the API without a time zone are shown a day early in browsers east of UTC
bug.symptoms: A reviewer's own review page says "Revealed 17 Nov" for reviews revealed on 18 Nov (04:53 UTC); the API sends "revealed_at":"2026-11-18T04:53:41" with no zone, the browser reads it as local time and the formatter prints the UTC day Search results show "17 Nov" while paper pages show "18 Nov" for the same instant
bug.reproduction_steps: Journey 13 steps 0 and 13 in a GMT+11 browser (screenshots/13-new-version-and-review-update/13b-solheim-review-page-v2.png, 00b-solheim-review-page-v1.png); journey 02 results
bug.expected: The shared date helper parses an ISO timestamp without a zone designator as UTC (the API's convention) before formatting in the viewer's zone; the review page's reveal date and the search results use the shared helper, so the same instant shows the same calendar date on every page; tests cover zone-less, Z and offset inputs in a non-UTC test time zone

bug.title: Small UI leftovers: raw "Under_review" on profiles, /ai lacks the paper title, lone "·" on /mod flag cards, "Discussion (2)" tab wraps
bug.symptoms: The author profile lists papers with the raw status slug "Under_review" The standalone /ai/{id} page is the only standalone paper page without the paper-title link /mod flag cards print a lone "·" between the record type and the paper title The "Discussion (2)" tab label wraps onto two lines at desktop width
bug.expected: Profiles use the shared status chip/labels ("Under review"); /ai/{id} shows the paper title linking to the paper like /reviews, /proof, /meta, /discussion; flag cards join their parts without dangling separators; paper tab labels never wrap (nowrap with the count in a badge) at widths of 768px and up
